# Call to action banner — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the call to action banner when the page ends with an ask: a primary-container closing section with title and actions. `title` is required — a call to action with no ask is decoration — with `description` carrying the ask and `actions` slotting the host's buttons. The primary container treatment is what marks it as the page's closing moment. There are no built-in actions — buttons arrive host-owned and the banner never navigates by itself — and there is no dismiss, because a closing section that vanishes is a popover rather than a banner. It renders as a labelled getting-started region, so the closing ask announces as its own section.
